title: Three Hundred Summers
summary: The gap between arriving and leaving: the years passing in the valley and the ache growing. Written deliberately with PHYSICAL ACTION in most shots -- 42 of the previous 55 shots were a person standing still talking, and this is the first script that asks characters to do things while they speak.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the green valley, silver waterfalls spilling into still pools, long summer light. No people. Static camera.
Medium shot from the waist up. The princess walks slowly through long grass as she speaks, one hand trailing across the seed heads. Static camera, she moves through the frame.

dialogue.line: You have been counting under your breath again. I can hear you doing it when you think I am asleep.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up. The warrior turns from the water to face her as he speaks, shoulders shifting. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Eleven thousand and some. I lost the thread of it somewhere in the second winter that never came.

scenes.visual: Medium shot. The princess lowers herself to sit on the grass as she speaks, gathering her gown. Static camera.

dialogue.line: There is no second winter. There is no first one. That is what I gave you, and you have been keeping accounts against it.

scenes.visual: Medium shot. The warrior crouches down beside her and picks up a stone from the grass, turning it over in his hand as he speaks. Static camera.

dialogue.line: This stone has not moved since I came here. Not one inch. At home a stone that size would be under a wall by now, or in a grave.

scenes.visual: Close-up. The princess turns her head to look at him, hair moving. Static camera.

dialogue.line: You talk about that place the way other men talk about a woman they did not marry.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot. The warrior stands up slowly as he speaks and lets the stone fall from his hand. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I talk about it the way a man talks about a room he left a lamp burning in. Something is still going on without me.

scenes.visual: Wide shot of the valley in low evening light, the pools very still, no wind. No people. Static camera.
Medium shot. The princess rises to her feet and steps toward him as she speaks, closing the distance. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then go and put it out. I have watched you be almost happy for a very long time and I would rather have you back properly or not at all.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The warrior looks down, then up at her, the decision arriving on his face. Static camera.

dialogue.line: You would let me go. After three hundred years you would actually let me go.

scenes.visual: Close-up. The princess holds his gaze without moving. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I would let you go. I never said I would let you stay away.
